*[This archive carries Josephus as dying in* **1782**](/person/josephus-defranceschi-1722/), *off a family tree.* **A scribe writing the same woman's father twice in April 1783, and marking him dead neither time, is a thin thing to build on — but it is two writings, not one.**

⚠ **And he is in neither death sequence for 1782.** *[Ten female deaths](/gologorica-line/#sterilis1783) and the male run of that year have been read; [the obit calendar has no Josephus either](/gologorica-line/#calendarindex).* ***So the tree's 1782 has no support in any of the three death books, and one contemporary entry — written twice — mildly contradicts it.*** **The year is not changed. It is now the most exposed figure on that row.**

bancich1782.heading: ⭐⭐⭐ The old parish priest dies, a Canon Franceschi gives him the last blessing, and a Vicar General of Pedena buries him
bancich1782.lead: **[This page has said that the cure passed from Bancich to a Defranceschi «between late 1780 and July 1782»](/gologorica-line/#parochus1782).** *The death register closes that window to a day, and the entry that does it is the richest single paragraph in the book.*
paras:
> «**Domo sub 55** · ***Die 25 Januarij hora nona elapsa ante meridiana obijt R.ᵐᵘˢ Archipresbiter et Parochus hujus loci GOLLOGORITIÆ D.ⁿᵘˢ MARCUS BANCICH, 75 annorum ætatis suæ***, *provisus in sua gravissima infirmitate Sacramentis Pœnitentiæ, Eucharistiæ, Extremæ Unctionis, nec non in articulo mortis Pontificiis benedictionis Apostolicæ* ***per CANONICUM FRANCESCHI***; *sepultus vero* **27** *in* ***Monumento Parochiali ante aram majorem in Ecclesia Parochiali S. Petri et Pauli Apost.***, *per Reverendissimum Dominum* ***Vicarium Generalem PETRUS SEGHER***, *et assistentes alios* **Canonicos Cathedralis PETINENSIS**, *nec non minus alios Parochos…*»

*(doc — DAPA* **ZM34K-214**, *M01068981,* «Liber Mortuorum II», *male sequence,* **25 January 1782**.)*
# ✔ The succession, dated

| | |
|---|---|
| **25 January 1782**, *9 a.m.* | **Marcus Bancich** *dies, aged* **75** — *Archpriest and Parish Priest of Gologorica* |
| **27 January 1782** | *buried* «**in Monumento Parochiali ante aram majorem**» |
| **13 March 1782** | «*provisa Sacramentis …* **per me Parochum Franceschi**» — *[the first signature of the new incumbent](/gologorica-line/#sterilis1783)* |

***Seven weeks.*** *And the man who died is the one who wrote almost everything this archive has read from this parish — [the burial of Leonardus the weaver in 1773](/gologorica-line/#textorexcarnia), [the marriage of his son in 1774](/gologorica-line/#marriage1774), [the baptism of his grandson in 1780](/person/joannes-petrus-defranceschi-1780/), [the župan's widow in 1774](/gologorica-line/#zupanwife).*
# ⭐⭐ «Per Canonicum Franceschi»
***The dying parish priest received the Apostolic blessing from the Canon Franceschi.***

*[Yesterday this archive found, in the last entry of the 1770–1781 baptisms](/gologorica-line/#houselist1770),* «*a Rev.ᵐᵒ D.* **Mathia Defranceschi**, *Canonico Titulari Ecclesiæ Cathedralis* **Petenensis**» — *and flagged it hard, because fourteen months earlier the same register gives the same title to* «**Mathias Baxa**».

**⭐ This entry puts the Canon Franceschi in the room.** *He attends the deathbed of the parish priest in January 1782; seven weeks later a* «Parochum Franceschi» *is signing the register.* ***The obvious reading is that they are one man — the canon who closed his predecessor's eyes and then took his cure.***

⚠ **It is still *inf*, and the Baxa objection is untouched.** *Neither entry gives the canon a forename here, and [this parish had two men styled titular canon of Pedena inside fourteen months](/gologorica-line/#houselist1770).* **What has changed is that the canon is no longer a single sighting in a baptism: he is present, named by office, at the central event of the parish's year.**
# ⭐⭐ And a Vicar General of Pedena, named
> «*sepultus … per Reverendissimum Dominum* ***Vicarium Generalem PETRUS SEGHER***, *et assistentes alios* **Canonicos Cathedralis Petinensis**»

**[Worklist 212 exists to find a named handle on the Pedena cathedral chapter](/worklist/)** — *the archive has wanted one [since the Count Damian baptism of 1720](/direct-line/), and has [exactly one: Francesco Agostino Corsi, Vicar General, 1732](/gologorica-line/).*

***Here is a second: PETRUS SEGHER, Vicar General of Pedena, at Gologorica on 27 January 1782, with the cathedral canons assisting.*** **A funeral attended by the Vicar General and the chapter is not an ordinary village burial** — *it is the diocese turning out for one of its archpriests, and it tells you what Bancich was.*

⚠ *The name is read* «**Segher**» *and magnified; the scribe writes the nominative* «Petrus» *where the grammar wants* «Petrum». **A Vicar General of Pedena in 1782 is a findable man, and this archive could not name one before today.**

⚠ **One number that does not fit, recorded rather than smoothed.** *The entry is headed* «**Domo sub 55**», *and [the 1770 house list puts the* **Parochia** *at* **69**](/gologorica-line/#houselist1770). ***Either the parish house was renumbered between 1770 and 1782, or the archpriest did not die in it.*** *[The renumbering problem has now produced three such pairs in two days.](/gologorica-line/#renumber)*

itemswept.heading: ✔ The whole of «Liber Baptizatorum III et Mortuorum II», swept — eight Defranceschi events out of a book nobody had opened
itemswept.lead: **On 30 September this item was a row in a frame map.** *[It was located, named* «Rođeni · Umrli · Vjenčani 1770–1789», *and never read.*](/gologorica-line/#framemap) ***It has now been read through for this surname, and its structure turns out to be nothing like the table's description.***
paras:
| frames | what is actually there | Defranceschi |
|---|---|---|
| **956–958** | «**Nota delle Case abitate, e disabitate**» — *[the house list, 1–130](/gologorica-line/#houselist1770)* | **45** *Leonardus→Antonius* · **46** *Joannes→Josephus* |
| **958–959** | *three blank printed return-forms* — «dei Battezzati», «dei Copulati», «dei Morti» | — |
| **959–966** | «**Notatio Baptizatorum MASCULORUM a 1ᵐᵒ Julij 1770**» | *[**Joannes Petrus**, house 45, 2 July 1780](/person/joannes-petrus-defranceschi-1780/)* |
| **967–974** | «**Notatio Baptizatorum FŒMINARUM**» | *none* |
| **975–985** | «**Notatio Defunctorum MASCULORUM**» | *[**Leonardus**, h.45, 14 Mar 1773,* «**Textor ex Carnia**»](/gologorica-line/#textorexcarnia) · *[**D.ⁿᵘˢ Joannes Petrus**, h.36, 8 Sep 1781](/person/pietro-defranceschi-1695/)* |
| **986–996** | «**Notatio Defunctarum FŒMINARUM**» | *[**Joanna**, h.46, 20 Apr 1774](/person/gisanna-defranceschi-1684/) · [**Margaretta**, h.36, 22 Apr 1783](/gologorica-line/#margaretta1783) · [**Catharina**, h.36, 12 Mar 1786](/person/catharina-defranceschi-d1786/)* |
| **997–1005** | «**Notatio Personarum Matrimonio junctarum a 1ᵐᵃ Julij 1770**» | *[**Joannes Baptista × Theresia**, 9 June 1774](/gologorica-line/#marriage1774)* |
| **1006** | *1768–69 marriages,* ***out of sequence***, *full narrative formula* | *[the Cooperator's signature](/gologorica-line/#parochus1782)* |
***Eight Defranceschi events, where the archive had none.*** **And four of the people in them had nothing behind their roster rows but a family tree.**

**⭐ The last of them, found on the final pass:** *[Catharina, twelve days old](/person/catharina-defranceschi-d1786/) —* «filia **Joannis Baptæ de Franceschi ejusque uxoris Catharinæ**». ***Her row has always said her parents were inferred from the index and the house. They are named here.***

**⚠ AND SHE SHOWS THAT TWO DEATH REGISTERS RAN AT ONCE.** *[Mortuorum II covers 1770–1789; Mortuorum III begins 1784](/gologorica-line/#bookseries).* ***Both record this child — same day, same house, one giving her age as eleven days and the other as twelve, one naming her parents and the other not.*** **Neither is a copy of the other.** *Anyone reading one of these books alone, for the years 1784–1789, is reading half the parish's record of its own dead.*

**⚠ What this sweep is and is not.** *Every frame of the item has been examined and every section read for one surname, with each hit magnified before transcription.* ***It is not a walk.*** *[`walked` means every entry](/method/), and the entries that do not carry this name were scanned, not read.* **A walk of this item would serve every family in the parish, and it has not been done.**

liberii1769.heading: ⭐⭐⭐ The second baptism book — a wife, four children, a canon, and a daughter married into Castel Roč
liberii1769.lead: **[The item just swept was* «Liber Baptizatorum III»](/gologorica-line/#itemswept).** *Beside it on the same reel sits* «**Liber Baptizatorum II.ᵈᵘˢ** … **1764**» — *[thirty-eight frames, a true baptism register](/searched/), running in parallel with the one begun in 1770.* ***It had never been opened either.***
paras: > **26 February 1769** · «*Maria filia legitima Josephi et Annæ jugalium* **Flegar** *… patrini fuerunt* ***Dominus Josephus Defranceschi et ROSALIA EJUSDEM FILIA***.»

> **16 March 1769** · «*Catharina filia legitima Stanislai et Dominicæ jugalium* **Crismanich** *… patrini fuerunt* ***Dominus Josephus Defranceschi, et HELENA UXOR EJUSDEM***.»

*(doc — DAPA* **ZM34K-214**, *M01068925,* «**Liber Baptizatorum II**» *1764–1788.)*
**Three weeks apart, and between them they do two things this archive has wanted.**
## ⭐ A marriage, thirty-five years before the widow

*[Josephus and Helena have been joined in this archive only by their daughter's death entry of 1783](/person/margarita-defranceschi-1747/) and by [Helena's own burial as his widow in 1804](/person/helena-defranceschi-1725/) — **two documents, both of them after the fact.*** ***Here they stand together at a font, as husband and wife, in March 1769.***
## ⭐⭐ And a third daughter, out of a row that was a name

*[«Rosalia Defranceschi» has sat in the roster with no dates, no source and no note](/person/rosalia-defranceschi-gologorica/).* ***She is standing godmother beside her father in February 1769, and the register says whose daughter she is.***

**So [the man whose entire row was the single word](/person/josephus-defranceschi-1722/)** «**Dominus**» **two days ago now has a wife and three daughters** — *[Rosalia](/person/rosalia-defranceschi-gologorica/) at the font in 1769, [Margarita](/person/margarita-defranceschi-1747/) dead at twenty-two in 1783, [Marianna](/person/marianna-defranceschi-fl-1780/) at the font in 1780.*

⚠ **Rosalia has no age and no dates.** *A godmother in 1769 is of an age to stand, commonly fourteen or more, so she was* ***born by about 1755*** — *an inference from the role, recorded as one.* ⚠ *And her mother is not named in her entry: [Helena is her father's wife three weeks later](/person/helena-defranceschi-1725/), which makes the identification* **inf**, *not* **doc**.

**⚠ And a word about why this book existed at all.** *It runs* **1764–1788** *and [the other baptism register runs 1770–1781](/gologorica-line/#itemswept) —* ***overlapping by eleven years***, *and [a third, Liber IV, begins in 1784](/gologorica-line/#bookseries).* **So for the 1780s this parish was keeping three baptism books and two death books at once.** *[The same doubling that let one child be recorded twice with different ages](/person/catharina-defranceschi-d1786/).* ***A reader who opens one of them has not read the parish.***
# ⭐⭐ And three years on, the same book gives him a SON

> **20 February 1772** · «*[Mat]hia filia legitima jugalium* **Leonardi et Catharinæ Deprato[—]** *baptizata est a me* **Marco Bancich Parocho hujus Loci**; *patrini fuerunt* ***D.ⁿᵘˢ JOANNES BAPTISTA DEFRANCESCHI FILIUS D.ⁿⁱ JOSEPHI, et ROSALIA FILIA EJUSDEM D.ⁿⁱ JOSEPHI***.»

*(doc — DAPA* **ZM34K-214**, *M01068930,* «Liber Baptizatorum II», **20 February 1772**. *The ink is faint; magnified before transcription.)*

**⭐ «Joannes Baptista Defranceschi, son of Dominus Josephus»** — *and [this archive's whole claim that that man had a father was his own burial, forty-one years later](/person/joannes-baptista-defranceschi-1752/):* «D.ⁿᵘˢ JOANNES BAPTA DEFRANCESCHI, VIDUUS, **defuncti Josephi filius**». ***Here he is at twenty, described the same way while his father was still alive.***

**⭐⭐ And the other godparent is his sister.** «**Rosalia filia ejusdem D.ⁿⁱ Josephi**» — *[the woman whose row was a name and a place this morning](/person/rosalia-defranceschi-gologorica/).* ***Brother and sister standing together at a font in February 1772.***

| [Josephus](/person/josephus-defranceschi-1722/)'s household, as the registers name it | |
|---|---|
| **[Helena](/person/helena-defranceschi-1725/)**, *his wife* | *at a font with him,* **1769** |
| **[Joannes Baptista](/person/joannes-baptista-defranceschi-1752/)** *b. 1752* | «filius D.ⁿⁱ Josephi», **1772** *— and his own burial, 1813* |
| **[Rosalia](/person/rosalia-defranceschi-gologorica/)** | «ejusdem filia» **1769**, «filia ejusdem D.ⁿⁱ Josephi» **1772** |
| **[Margarita](/person/margarita-defranceschi-1747/)** *d. 1783 at 22* | «filia Josephi et Hellenæ jugalium», *[written twice](/gologorica-line/#textorexcarnia)* |
| **[Marianna](/person/marianna-defranceschi-fl-1780/)** | «filia Domini Josephi Defranceschi», **1780** |
***Two days ago this man was the single word* «Dominus» *on a roster row. He now has a wife and four children, every one of them named as his in a register.***

⚠ **And the child they stood for is not one of ours — the trap caught again.** *At page scale the parents read* «Leonardi et Catharinæ **Defranceschi**». *At magnification the surname is* «**Deprato[—]**», *and [a Leonardus Deprato is a documented householder here who died in 1784 aged sixty](/gologorica-line/#textorexcarnia).* ***[This village's standing warning claimed another reading, and the same rule that always catches it caught it.](/gologorica-line/)***
# ⭐⭐ 1776 — and the OTHER house appears, with the bride of 1774

> **13 December 1776** · «*Mathias filius legitimus* **Joannis Udovicich Jacotich** *ejusque uxoris Helenæ baptizatus est a me* **Marco Bancich Parocho hujus Loci**; *patrini fuerunt* ***ANTONIUS DEFRANCESCHI, et THERESIA JOANNIS BAPTISTÆ DEFRANCESCHI UXOR***.» *(M01068935.)*

***«Theresia, wife of Joannes Baptista Defranceschi»*** — *[the Krbune bride of 9 June 1774](/gologorica-line/#marriage1774), standing godmother two and a half years after her wedding.* **Her earliest appearance in this archive; [the next is a baptism in 1785](/person/franciscus-antonius-defranceschi-1785/).**

**⭐ And beside her, [ANTONIUS DEFRANCESCHI](/person/antonius-defranceschi-1742/)** — *the man [whose death of 1802 calls him* «**q. Leonardo**»](/person/antonius-defranceschi-1742/), *and therefore* ***her husband's brother.*** *[His earliest appearance was 1782 yesterday; it is now 1776.](/person/antonius-defranceschi-1742/)* **The Leonardus house, two of its people, at one font.**
# ⭐⭐⭐ 1781 — and the other house turns out to have married into a castle

> **Die 20 Junij** · «***Antonius Aloysius Nicolò*** *natus die* **12 Junij**, *filius legitimus Domini* ***Joannis Andreæ Nicolò DE CASTRO ROZZI***, *et* ***MARIANNA ejus uxoris, FILIA DOMINI JOSEPHI DEFRANCESCHI***, *baptizatus est a* ***R.ᵐᵒ D.ⁿᵒ MATHIA DEFRANCESCHI, Canonico TITULARI Cathedralis Ecclesiæ PETINENSIS***, *de licentia Parochi … patrini fuerunt D.ⁿᵘˢ* **Joannes Baptista Defranceschi**, *et* **Maria uxor D.ⁿⁱ Antonij Covaz Pisinensis**.»

*(doc — DAPA* **ZM34K-214**, *M01068940,* «Liber Baptizatorum II», **20 June 1781**.)*

| | |
|---|---|
| **[Marianna](/person/marianna-defranceschi-fl-1780/)**, *Josephus's daughter* | *wife of* ***Dominus Joannes Andreas Nicolò DE CASTRO ROZZI*** — *of the castle of* **Roč** |
| *her son* | ***Antonius Aloysius Nicolò***, *born 12 June 1781* |
| *who baptised him* | ***R.ᵐᵘˢ Mathias Defranceschi, Titular Canon of Pedena cathedral***, *de licentia Parochi* |
| *godfather* | **[Joannes Baptista Defranceschi](/person/joannes-baptista-defranceschi-1752/)** — *her brother* |
| *godmother* | **Maria, wife of D.ⁿⁱ Antonius Covaz of Pazin** |

***A daughter of this house married a lord of Castel Roč; a Defranceschi canon of Pedena baptised the child; her brother stood godfather.*** **That is the family's standing set out in one paragraph**, *and yesterday Marianna was a name in a godparent list and Josephus was the word* «Dominus».
## ✔ And it settles the canon

*[Yesterday a* «**Mathia Defranceschi**, Canonico Titulari Ecclesiæ Cathedralis Petenensis» *turned up once, in the last entry of another book, and was flagged hard](/gologorica-line/#houselist1770) — *because the same register gave that title to a* **Baxa** *fourteen months earlier, and a single sighting of a canon is a thin thing.*

***Here he is a second time, in a second book, in the same year — baptising his own kinswoman's son by licence of the parish priest.*** **And [he attends the dying parish priest seven months later](/gologorica-line/#bancich1782).** *Three appearances, three books.* **The canon is real.**

⚠ **The Baxa objection is untouched and stays.** *Two men could be titular canons of one cathedral at once — that is what* «titular» *means.* ⚠ *And whether this canon is [the parish priest who succeeded Bancich](/person/joannes-mathias-franceschi-gologorica/) is still* **inf**: *the chronology fits and no entry gives the canon a second forename.*

⚠ **One name noted and not chased:** «**Maria uxor D.ⁿⁱ Antonij COVAZ Pisinensis**». *[This archive holds a* «Maria Defranceschi (Covaz)» *among five Rijeka rows whose dates it had to clear as a name-matching artefact](/corrections/) — ***and [the Maire of Pazin who seized the registers in 1812 has a surname this archive could not read, ending* «—ovaz»](/gologorica-line/#french1812).*** **Recorded as a thread, claimed as nothing.**

twojb1786.heading: ⭐⭐⭐ The priest tells the two Joannes Baptistas apart himself, in one sentence, by their wives
twojb1786.lead: **[This archive has spent weeks separating the two Joannes Baptista Defranceschi of Gologorica](/gologorica-line/#marriage1774)** — *by house number, by index byname, by patronymic, by wife.* ***On 3 October 1786 the parish priest did it in a single sentence, because he needed to.***
paras:
> **Die 3 Octobris 1786** · «*Ego Parochus hujus loci baptizavi filiam legitimam natam ex* **Thoma et Maria Udovicich Gospöt** *… cui impositum est nomen* **Justina**. *Patrini fuerunt* ***JOANNES BAPTA DEFRANCESCHI MARITUS THERESIÆ***, *et* ***CATTARINA NATA JABLICH UXOR JOANNIS BAPTISTÆ FILIJ JOSEPHI DEFRANCESCHI***, *ambo ex hac Parochia.*»

*(doc — DAPA* **ZM34K-214**, *M01068950,* «Liber Baptizatorum II», **3 October 1786**.)*

| the scribe writes | which man |
|---|---|
| «**Joannes Bapta Defranceschi, MARITUS THERESIÆ**» | *[the weaver's son of house 45, married at Gologorica in 1774 to Theresia Grah of Krbune](/gologorica-line/#marriage1774)* |
| «**uxor Joannis Baptistæ FILIJ JOSEPHI Defranceschi**» | *[the house-36 man, whose burial of 1813 calls him* «defuncti Josephi filius»](/person/joannes-baptista-defranceschi-1752/) |

***Two men of one name and one surname, in one parish, standing at one font — and the priest distinguishes them the way a parish actually does: by whose husband one is and whose wife the other brought.***
**✔ And it makes the sonship *doc* a second time.** *[The 1772 entry already called him* «filius D.ⁿⁱ Josephi»](/gologorica-line/#liberii1769); *here it is again, fourteen years on, in another book.*
# ✔✔ And it settles the surname question from the Istrian side

*[Two days ago this archive proved the Bakar register writes* «**Sablich**»](/gologorica-line/#bakar1783) — *from inside the entry, because the same scribe opens* «**Sa**bastiani» *with the identical letter and Sebastian can only begin with an S.* **It then said, carefully, that this did not make Gologorica's** «**Jablich**» **a misreading** — *that the discrepancy was probably two scribes and not two readings.*
***The same test can now be run on the Istrian side, and it passes.***
> «*et Cattarina nata* **Jablich** *uxor* **Joan-** | **-nis** Baptistæ filij **Josephi** Defranceschi»

**The J of** «**Jablich**» **drops a long descender and hooks left — exactly like the J of** «**Joan**[nis]» **two words later and** «**Josephi**» **on the line below**, *in the same hand, within fifteen letters.*
> ***Bakar writes SABLICH and proves its S. Gologorica writes JABLICH and proves its J. Both spellings are now demonstrated, each against its own scribe.***

**So the reading published two days ago stands and is now symmetrical:** *the difference is* **two scribes a hundred and thirty kilometres apart**, *not a misreading at either end — an Istrian priest writing down a Kvarner name he had heard spoken, and a Kvarner priest writing his own parishioner's.* ⚠ *[Her row keeps both forms and her pid stays frozen.](/person/catharina-defranceschi-jablich-gologorica/)*
⚠ **One word read with less certainty than the rest:** «**maritus**». *The hand compresses it; the sense is not in doubt and the letters are not perfectly clear. It is recorded as read.*

supanus1764.heading: ⭐⭐⭐ The first page of Liber II names a ŽUPAN of Gologorica in full — and puts the Defranceschi priest at a font four years before anyone knew he was there
supanus1764.lead: **[Liber Baptizatorum II was opened yesterday](/gologorica-line/#liberii1769) and five of its thirty-eight frames were read.** *Its* ***first text page*** *was not among them.* **M01068918 opens** «N.º 1 · *Gollogoritia* · 3 Januarij **1764**» *— and before April is out it has settled two things this archive had been approaching from other directions entirely.*
paras: # ⭐⭐⭐ «Domina Supana Joanna, vidua defuncti D.ⁿⁱ Supani JOANNIS BAPTISTÆ DEFRANCESCHI»

> **26 Aprilis 1764** · «*Ego* **Marcus Bancich** *Parochus hujus Parochialis Ecclesiæ SS.ᵐᵒʳᵘᵐ Apostolorum Petri et Pauli baptizavi* **Joannem** *filium legitimum* **Joannis et Olivæ** *jugalium* **Udovcich** *; patrini fuere* **D.ⁿᵘˢ Matheus Flegar**, *et* ***Domina Supana Joanna vidua defuncti D.ⁿⁱ Supani Joannis Baptistæ Defranceschi***.»

*(doc — DAPA* **ZM34K-214**, *M01068918, «Liber Baptizatorum II», in the hand of* **Marcus Bancich**.*)*
**It does three things, and the third is the one the archive could not get.**

**1 · The župan is named in full, by his own parish.** *[The entry that made him known](/person/gisanna-defranceschi-1684/) was his widow's burial in 1774, and it calls him only* «**Supani Joannis Defranceschi**» — *so the archive's own note records that* ***«the death entry abbreviates the husband to «Joannis» where the Gračišće ones give «Joannis Baptistæ»».*** **Gologorica now writes «Joannis Baptistæ» itself**, *ten years earlier, in the same priest's hand.* *The forename pair no longer has to be carried in from another parish.*
**2 · He was dead by 26 April 1764.** *The 1774 burial gives no date for him at all — only that she was his widow. This is a* ***terminus ante quem*** *the archive did not have.*

**3 · And she is alive at a font, with the title in her own right.** «**Domina Supana**» — *not* «vidua Supani» *but* **Supana**, *the headman's style in the feminine, ten years after his death and while she is about eighty.* *[She is buried in the family's* arca *under the floor of the parish church on 21 April 1774](/person/gisanna-defranceschi-1684/)* — ***five days short of ten years after she stood at this font.***
# ⚠⚠ And a collision, named rather than resolved

**This archive now holds three men called Joannes Baptista Defranceschi at Gologorica inside sixty years, and is joining none of them.**

| | |
|---|---|
| **[dead by August 1709](/person/joannes-baptista-defranceschi-of-gologorica-d-by-1709/)** | *wife* **Lucia**, *daughter* **Vittoria** — *both entered* «q.» *in the obit calendar* |
| **the župan** | *dead by* **26 April 1764**, *widow* **Joanna**, *house* **46** |
| *«the elder»* | *a tree year and nothing else:* **died 1767** |

⚠ **The 1709 man is not the župan.** *His wife* **Lucia** *was still* «moglie di q. Gio: Batta» *in* **1720** — *a man does not leave two widows who each survive him by decades.*

⚠ **And a man who died in 1767 cannot be «defuncti» in April 1764** — *but [a tree year is an interval, not a point](/method/), that row carries nothing behind it but a tree, and the collision is close enough to be worth saying out loud.* ***No row is merged on this.*** *[The standing warning about this village's repeating forenames](/gologorica-line/) gains a third instance instead.*
# ⭐⭐ «Ego Mathias Defranceschi … Sacerdos, DE LICENTIA PAROCHI»

> **18 Februarij 1764** · «*Ego* ***Mathias Defranceschi*** *[—]ᵘˢ* **Sacerdos** *de licentia Parochi baptizavi* **Mathiam** *filiam legitimam defuncti* **Thomæ** *ac* **Mathiæ** *jugalium* **Zabran alias Strapich**; *patrini fuerunt* **Georgius Senčich** *ac* **Mathias Senčich**…»

*(doc — DAPA* **ZM34K-214**, *M01068918, in the writer's own hand, between two entries of Marcus Bancich.)*

**Until this page was opened, the Defranceschi priest's earliest appearance in any book was 1768, as [COOPERATOR](/gologorica-line/#parochus1782).** ***This is four years earlier*** — *and the formula states precisely what he was not.*

«**De licentia Parochi**» — ***by leave of the parish priest***. *He held no office in this parish in February 1764. The* **Parochus** *is* **Marcus Bancich**, *who writes the entry before this one and the entry after it; the young priest borrows the book for a single baptism and hands it back.*

*(****doc*** *that a priest of this surname stood at the font at Gologorica on* **18 February 1764**. ***inf*** *that he is [the man who signs* «Ego Joannes Matthias de Franceschi, Parocus hujus loci» *in 1788](/gologorica-line/#parochus1782) and [who died at Gologorica in 1798, aged sixty-two](/person/joannes-mathias-franceschi-gologorica/) — on the second forename, the surname, the parish and the arithmetic: born about* **1736**, *he is* **twenty-eight** *here, which is what a newly ordained priest baptising by another man's leave looks like.)*

⚠ **One word is not settled, and is not being guessed.** *Between the surname and* «Sacerdos» *stands a word of seven or eight letters, read at six times native resolution:* «**Pe**» *or* «**Ve**», *a tall looped letter, a dotted* **i**, *then* «**nus**». *It may be a title; it may be* «**Petinus**» *— of* **Pedena**, *the diocese this parish sits in.* **[Nothing is read off a doubtful word without a second construction](/method/)**, *and this is a hand with one entry in it. [Thirty-three frames of this book remain unread](/searched/) and may supply another.* ***Until they do it stands as*** «**[—]ᵘˢ**».

supana1767.heading: ⭐⭐⭐ The same priest writes «Supani Joannis Baptistæ Defranceschi» three times in three years — and the sweep hands back the second construction it was promised
supana1767.lead: **[The first page of Liber II gave the župan his forename pair this morning](/gologorica-line/#supanus1764)**, *and the row it produced said the same thing twice over: one entry, one hand, and [a doubtful word left standing as* «[—]ᵘˢ» *because a hand with one entry in it cannot be read against itself](/method/).* ***Three frames later the book has answered both.***
paras: # ⭐⭐⭐ Three constructions, one scribe, 1764 · 1765 · 1767

| | | |
|---|---|---|
| **26 Apr 1764** | *M01068918* | «***Domina Supana Joanna vidua defuncti D.ⁿⁱ Supani Joannis Baptistæ Defranceschi***» |
| **24 Sep 1765** | *M01068919* | «***Joanna uxor defuncti Supani Joannis Baptistæ Defranceschi***» |
| **14 Feb 1767** | *M01068921* | «***Joanna uxor defuncti Supani Joannis Baptistæ Defranceschi***» |

*(doc — DAPA* **ZM34K-214**, *all three in the hand of* **Marcus Bancich**, *parish priest.)*

**The forename pair is no longer a single reading.** *[His widow's burial in 1774 abbreviates him to* «Supani **Joannis** Defranceschi»](/person/gisanna-defranceschi-1684/) *— the only form this archive had from Gologorica until today. His own parish now writes* «**Joannis Baptistæ**» ***three times in thirty-four months***, *and [his row rests on three entries rather than one](/person/joannes-baptista-defranceschi-supanus-d-by-1764/).*

**⭐ And his widow is alive through all three.** *She is a godmother in* **1764**, *in* **1765** *and in* **1767**, *twice beside the same man —* **Thomas Flegar** — *and twice for children of the* **Udovcich Gospood**. *[She dies on 20 April 1774, aged ninety* circiter*](/person/gisanna-defranceschi-1684/):* ***so she stood at fonts into her eighties, a decade after her husband was already «defuncti».***
# ⭐⭐ The office did not stay in the house

> **16 Decembris 1764** · «*baptizavi* **Luciam** *filiam legitimam* ***Supani Martini et Mariæ jugalium Udovcich Gospood***; *patrini fuere* ***D.ⁿᵘˢ Joseph Defranceschi*** *et* **Lucia uxor defuncti Lucæ Dujanich ex Novaco**»

**Eight months after the Defranceschi župan is entered as dead, the register gives the title to another man.** «**Supanus Martinus Udovcich Gospood**» *— and [his children are the ones Joanna stands for in 1765 and 1767](/gologorica-line/#supana1767), which is what a village looks like when an office moves between two families that still christen each other's children.*

⚠ *This is what the register says, not a succession list. **Nothing is claimed about who held the office between them.***

**⭐ And the godfather is Josephus, four years earlier than the archive had him.** *[His earliest appearance was 26 February 1769](/person/josephus-defranceschi-1722/), standing with his daughter Rosalia.* ***This is 16 December 1764***, *and he is* «**Dominus**» *here too —* [*the word that was once the whole of his row*](/person/josephus-defranceschi-1722/).
# ✔✔ And the flag raised this morning is discharged
> **15 Octobris 1766** · «*patrini fuerunt* ***R.ᵈᵘˢ D. Mathias Defranceschi*** *et* **Euphemia uxor Judicis Antonij Flegar ex Novaco**»

**[This morning the priest's 1764 entry carried a word between the surname and «Sacerdos» that was not settled](/gologorica-line/#supanus1764)**, *and the row said so:* «*thirty-three frames of this book remain unread and may supply the second construction*». ***Two frames later one did.***

**The forename is written out by a different hand — Marcus Bancich's, not his own — and it reads «Mathias Defranceschi», exactly as in February 1764.** *He now carries a clerical style:* «**R.ᵈᵘˢ D.**», ***Reverendus Dominus***. *So in* **1764** *he is a priest with no office in this parish, baptising* «de licentia Parochi»; *in* **1766** *he is a* **Reverendus Dominus** *standing as godfather; by* **1768** *[he is* **Cooperator**](/gologorica-line/#parochus1782); *by* **1782** *[he is* **Parochus**](/gologorica-line/#parochus1782).

⚠ **The doubtful word itself is still not read.** *What is discharged is the* ***name*** *— «Mathias Defranceschi» is now written twice, by two hands, two years apart. The word between it and* «Sacerdos» *in the 1764 entry remains* «[—]ᵘˢ», *and [it will stay that way until something construes it](/method/), not until something makes it plausible.*

petrus1768.heading: ⭐⭐⭐ A row that was a census line and a tree year gets its baptism, its parents and a second forename — and an archpriest came over from Cerovlje to give it
petrus1768.lead: **[Petrus Defranceschi's row has carried one sentence of evidence since 30 September](/person/petrus-defranceschi-1768/):** *the 1826* status animarum *enters him* «**civilitas**», ***born 17 April 1768***, *in a struck-through household, dead 1829 at sixty-one.* **No parents. No baptism. No house.** *Two frames on from this morning's work, the register that should hold his baptism was opened.*
paras: # ⭐⭐⭐ «Die 17 Aprilis» — the same day, written at the time

> «***Archipresbyter et Parochus Cerovglienensis Dominicus Clinzich*** *baptizavit* ***PETRUM ANTONIUM*** *filium legitimum* ***D.ⁿⁱ Josephi, et Helenæ jugalium DEFRANCESCHI***; *patrini fuerunt* **Josephus Belch**, *et* **Matthia uxor Jacobi Rovis q.ᵐ Matthæi**, *ambo* ***PISINENSES***.»

*(doc — DAPA* **ZM34K-214**, *M01068923, «Liber Baptizatorum II», 17 April 1768.)*

**The day matches to the day.** *The census of 1826 and the register of 1768 are fifty-eight years apart and agree on* **17 April 1768**, *in a parish of this size, for a man of this name. [The row is no longer a tree year and a census line.](/person/petrus-defranceschi-1768/)*

**And it gives him everything the row lacked:**

| | |
|---|---|
| **his full name** | ***Petrus Antonius*** — *a second forename nothing else records* |
| **his father** | «**D.ⁿᵘˢ Josephus Defranceschi**» — *[the man whose whole row was once the word* «Dominus»](/person/josephus-defranceschi-1722/) |
| **his mother** | «**Helena**», *named as his wife* |
| **his sister** | *[**Rosalia**, who stands as godmother with their father in February 1769](/gologorica-line/#liberii1769)* |

**⭐⭐ And look who was asked to do it.** *Not the parish priest.* «***Dominicus Clinzich, Archipresbyter et Parochus Cerovglienensis***» — ***the archpriest of Cerovlje***, *from the next parish, with* **Marcus Bancich** *writing in his own book either side of the entry. The godparents are* «**ambo Pisinenses**» — ***both from Pazin***.

*An outside archpriest and two townspeople from the district capital, for a child whose father is* «Dominus». ***That is the same household the 1826 census would still be calling* «civilitas» *fifty-eight years later***, *and it is [the conditio the Gračišće register gives these people over and over](/gologorica-line/) — not* «rustici».
# ⭐⭐ The godparent clause of the year before, and a name twenty years absent

> **11 Martij 1767** · «*baptizavi* **Josephum** *filium legitimum* **Leonardi, et Catharinæ** *jugalium* ***DEPRATTO***; *patrini fuerunt* ***D.ⁿᵘˢ Joannes Petrus Defranceschi*** *et* ***Helena uxor D.ⁿⁱ Josephi Defranceschi***.»

*(doc — DAPA* **ZM34K-214**, *M01068922.)*

**⭐ Helena is named as Josephus's wife two years earlier than the archive had her** — *[the 1769 entries call her only* «Helena uxor ejusdem»](/gologorica-line/#liberii1769) — *and she is a godmother in her own right the year before her son is born.*

**⭐⭐ And «Dominus Joannes Petrus Defranceschi» is back.** *[His row holds three dated appearances — 1744, 1747, 1750, all as a godfather at Gračišće](/person/joannes-petrus-defranceschi-gologorica/), and then nothing.* ***This is a fourth, seventeen years after the third, in his own parish.***

⚠ *[The archive already suspects that row and* «**Sig.ʳ Giovanni Pietro Defranceschi, N.º 36, d'anni 86½**», *dead 1781, are one man](/person/pietro-defranceschi-1695/) — its own note says* «probably a second roster row». ***This entry is consistent with that and does not prove it***: *a man born about March 1695 is* **seventy-two** *in March 1767, and* «Dominus» *is the Latin of* «Sig.ʳ». **The two rows are still not joined**, *and [the standing warning about this village's forenames](/gologorica-line/) is why.*
# ✔ And a bishop signs the book
> «*Die* **15.ᵗᵃ Julij 1768** *in prima Nostra G[enera]li Visitatione* · ***Revisus, et approbatus*** · **Aldragus Ant.ᵘˢ Ep.ᵘˢ PETINENSIS**»

**The register carries the Bishop of Pedena's own hand, at his first general visitation, two months after the baptism above.** *It is the kind of line that dates a book's custody rather than a person, and it is worth recording for anyone who comes to this volume after us.*

**✔ It also does one small thing to [this morning's unsettled word](/gologorica-line/#supanus1764).** *One candidate for it was* «**Petinus**» *— of Pedena.* ***This book writes the adjective for Pedena itself, and it writes it* «PETINENSIS».** *That is the volume read against itself, and it makes* «Petinus» *the weaker reading. It does not supply a better one.* **The word stands as «[—]ᵘˢ».**

twofathers1769.heading: ⭐⭐⭐ One opening, three months apart: «filius Leonardi» and «filius D.ni Josephi» — the parish tells the two Joannes Baptistas apart by their FATHERS, seventeen years before it does it by their wives
twofathers1769.lead: **[This archive published the 1786 entry in which the priest separates the two same-named men by naming their wives](/gologorica-line/#twojb1786)** — *and called it the priest doing the archive's work for it.* ***He had been doing it since 1769, on a single opening, and this is the page.***
paras: # ⭐⭐⭐ Three months, one scribe, two fathers

> **24 Septembris 1769** · «*patrini fuerunt* ***Joannes Baptista Defranceschi FILIUS LEONARDI***, *et* **Mathia uxor Pauli Crosgnich**, *ambo hujates*»

> **18 Decembris 1769** · «*patrini fuerunt* ***D.ⁿᵘˢ Joannes Baptista FILIUS D.ⁿⁱ JOSEPHI Defranceschi***, *et* **Helena uxor ejusdem D.ⁿⁱ Josephi**, *hujates*»

*(doc — DAPA* **ZM34K-214**, *M01068926, both on the left-hand page of one opening, in the hand of* **Marcus Bancich**.*)*

**Marcus Bancich had two parishioners of the same name and he never once left them ambiguous.** *In September he writes the patronymic of one; in December the patronymic of the other, on the same page, twelve weeks apart. [Seventeen years later his successor does the same job with their wives.](/gologorica-line/#twojb1786)*
# ⭐⭐ «filius Leonardi» — and Leonardus is still alive

**[The 1774 marriage calls this man «Joannes Baptista Defranceschi *q.ᵐ Leonardi* filius»](/person/joannes-baptista-defranceschi-detti-leonardi-m-1774/)** — *the* «q.ᵐ» *for* quondam, *the late.* ***On 24 September 1769 the «q.ᵐ» is not there.***

*So the register says Leonardus was living in September 1769 and dead by June 1774 — and [this archive found him dying between those dates](/gologorica-line/#textorexcarnia):*

> **45** · «*Die* **14 Martij** [1773] *obijt* ***Leonardus Defranceschi annorum septuaginta sex*** … *sepultus 15 in Arca D.ni Petri Defranceschi* … *(: professionis suæ* ***TEXTOR EX CARNIA*** *:)*»

***Two entries written four and a half years apart, by hands that were not checking each other, and the «q.ᵐ» appears exactly where the death register puts it.***

**⭐ And it is the groom of 1774 five years before his wedding.** *[His row began life as a byname in a clerk's index](/person/joannes-baptista-defranceschi-detti-leonardi-m-1774/) and had nothing on it before June 1774.* **This is September 1769**, *and he is already a man who stands at fonts.*
# ⭐⭐ «filius D.ni Josephi» — the earliest of four

**[Josephus's son's sonship is one of the best-attested facts in this archive's eighteenth century](/person/joannes-baptista-defranceschi-1752/)** — *written out in* **1772**, *again in* **1786**, *and a last time in his own death entry of* **1813**: «*D.ⁿᵘˢ Joannes Bapta Defranceschi, viduus,* ***defuncti Josephi filius***». ***This is 18 December 1769, and it is now the earliest of four.***

⚠ **He would be seventeen.** *[His death entry of 1813 gives his age as sixty](/person/joannes-baptista-defranceschi-1752/), which puts his birth about October 1752.* *Seventeen is young for a godfather and not impossible, and nothing here depends on it — [the sonship is doc three further times](/person/joannes-baptista-defranceschi-1752/). **It is recorded as the arithmetic of the entry, not as a reason to doubt it or to adjust a birth year.***

**⭐ And the two branches do not carry the same style.** *In the same hand, twelve weeks apart:* **Josephus's son is** «**D.ⁿᵘˢ**»; **Leonardus's son is not.** *[Leonardus is a weaver out of Carnia](/gologorica-line/#textorexcarnia) and [his son is entered* «professionis suæ Textor» *at his marriage](/person/joannes-baptista-defranceschi-detti-leonardi-m-1774/); [Josephus's household takes an archpriest from the next parish and godparents from Pazin to its christenings](/gologorica-line/#petrus1768).* ⚠ *One pair of entries is a thin basis for a social claim, and this is offered as what the page shows.*
# ✔ And the widow, a fourth time
> **5 Februarij 1770** · «*patrini fuerunt* **Simon Bugich ex territorio Boruti**, *et* ***Joanna VIDUA defuncti Joannis Baptistæ Defranceschi***, *hujas*»

*[The forename pair now stands on four entries](/person/joannes-baptista-defranceschi-supanus-d-by-1764/) — 1764, 1765, 1767, 1770 — and she is a godmother in all four. **She is about eighty-six here**, and [she has four years to live](/person/gisanna-defranceschi-1684/).*

cerovljeslip.heading: ⭐⭐ A loose slip lying inside the book — a Cerovlje extract of 1793 — names the archpriest this archive published four hours ago, and explains a frame that looks like film debris
cerovljeslip.lead: **M01068929 and M01068930 are the same opening of «Liber Baptizatorum II», photographed twice.** *The second is clean. On the first, a* ***loose leaf of paper is lying across both pages***, *obscuring part of each — and it is not part of the register at all.*
paras: # ⭐⭐ What is on the slip

> «*Die* **5. Januarij 1767.** *Antonia filia legitima* **Michaelis, et Apoloniæ** *jugalium* **Persevich** *baptizata fuit a me* ***Archipræsbitero et Parocho Dominico Clinzich***. *Patrini fuere* **Judex Georgius, et ejus Nepos Oliva Grach**, *ambo ex* **Cerovglie**.
>
> *Die* **12. 8bris 1770.** *Catharinam filiam legitimam, et* ***posthumam*** **Michaelis et Apoloniæ** *jugalium* **Persevich** *baptizavit* ***Gregorius Bosich Vice-Parochus***, *quam ad sacrum fontem levavit* **Mathæus Persevich** *et* **Lucia uxor Thomæ Persevich**, *ambo ex hac Villa* **Cerovglie**.
>
> ***Sic de verbo ad verbum ex Libro Baptizatorum descripsit*** · *Die* **18. Aprilis 1793.** · **Laurentius Vicich m.p.ᵃ, Parochus**»

**A certified extract from the baptism book of CEROVLJE, copied out word for word in 1793 and left inside the Gologorica register, where it has stayed long enough to be microfilmed.** *It concerns the* **Persevich** *of Cerovlje and carries no Defranceschi.*
# ⭐⭐ But it corroborates something published this morning

**[Four hours ago this archive published the baptism of Petrus Antonius Defranceschi](/gologorica-line/#petrus1768)**, *17 April 1768, and the striking thing about it was the officiant: not the parish priest but* «***Archipresbyter et Parochus Cerovglienensis Dominicus Clinzich***», *come over from the next parish.*

***The slip has him in his own book, fifteen months earlier, with the same office and the same name*** — «Archipræsbitero et Parocho **Dominico Clinzich**» — *and it was written out by a successor of his in 1793, from the Cerovlje register, for reasons that had nothing to do with this family.* **Two independent documents, two parishes, one man.**
*It also gives Cerovlje a* **Vice-Parochus**, **Gregorius Bosich**, *in October 1770, and a* **Parochus Laurentius Vicich** *in April 1793 — neither of whom this archive had.*
# ✔ And it clears up a frame that looks like film debris

**A reel that shows the same opening twice invites the reading that one exposure was spoiled and repeated.** *That is not what happened here.* ***The two frames differ by a document***: *M01068929 has the slip on the page, M01068930 does not.* **Somebody lifted it between exposures**, *and the sequence is a deliberate record of an insert, not a duplicate.*

⚠ *So* **M01068929 cannot be read entry by entry on its own** *— part of two pages is under paper. [It is M01068930 that this archive has read](/gologorica-line/), and the searched row says so.* ***A frame obscured by an insert is not a frame read, and a repeated opening on a reel is worth looking at before it is dismissed.***
# ✔ And a fifth time for the sonship

> **19 Septembris 1770** · «*patrini fuerunt* ***D.ⁿᵘˢ Joannes Baptista filius D.ⁿⁱ Josephi Defranceschi***, *et* **Helena uxor ejusdem Defranceschi**» — *at the baptism of* **Catharina**, «*filia* ***posthuma***» *of the late* **Josephus Flegar** *and Anna. (M01068927.)*

*[The sonship is now written in 1769, 1770, 1772, 1786 and in his death entry of 1813](/person/joannes-baptista-defranceschi-1752/).*

⚠ **And here «ejusdem» is genuinely ambiguous** — *it could make Helena the wife of the son rather than of the father.* ***The December 1769 entry on the facing page of another opening settles it***: *the same pair, and there the priest writes* «**Helena uxor ejusdem D.ⁿⁱ JOSEPHI**» *in full. [That is the volume read against itself](/method/), and it is why the ambiguous one is not read as a marriage.*
